description: This file defines an API endpoint class for managing employee personal details within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve (GET) and update (PUT) personal information of employees via RESTful API routes, including validation rules and configurations for legacy fields and country-specific data.

classes.name: EmployeePersonalDetailAPI
classes.description: REST API endpoint class for accessing and updating an employee's personal details, handling validation, configuration flags, and data serialization.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific employee's personal details based on employee number.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET request, primarily validating the employee number.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an employee's personal details, including validation and conditional handling of deprecated and country-specific fields.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating employee personal details, including required fields and optional country or legacy fields.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws exception if called.
